# Test fixtures

`basic_test_ppt_file.ppt`, `SampleShow.ppt` and `SampleDoc.doc` are sample files from the
[Apache POI](https://poi.apache.org/) project's test data
(<https://github.com/apache/poi/tree/trunk/test-data>), used under the Apache License 2.0.
They are real PowerPoint 97-2003 and Word 97-2003 files; `basic_test_ppt_file.ppt` was saved
with fast save, so it also holds stale copies of its slides.
